# EnterF1.com

> Your Ultimate F1 Race Guide — independent fan site covering the 2026 Formula 1 season with race guides, team and driver profiles, grandstand seating guides, TV schedules, and ticket information.

## About

EnterF1.com is an independent Formula 1 fan website. It provides comprehensive race weekend guides for all 24 races in the 2026 F1 season, including circuit information, where-to-sit grandstand guides, travel tips, TV broadcast schedules (UK), and ticket buying advice. The site covers all 11 teams and 22 drivers competing in the 2026 championship.

## Key Facts

- **Season:** 2026 Formula 1 World Championship
- **Races:** 24 (note: Bahrain and Saudi Arabian GPs listed as cancelled)
- **Teams:** 11
- **Drivers:** 22
- **Coverage:** UK-focused (TV times for Sky Sports F1 and Channel 4)
- **Independence:** Not affiliated with Formula 1, FIA, or any team

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.enterf1.com/) — Next race countdown, season overview, teams and drivers
- [Race Calendar](https://www.enterf1.com/races/) — All 24 races with dates and circuit info
- [Teams](https://www.enterf1.com/teams/) — All 11 F1 teams with driver lineups
- [Drivers](https://www.enterf1.com/drivers/) — All 22 F1 drivers with profiles
- [Results](https://www.enterf1.com/results/) — Race results and championship standings
- [TV Schedule](https://www.enterf1.com/f1-tv-schedule.php) — UK broadcast times (Sky Sports F1 / Channel 4)
- [Where to Buy F1 Tickets](https://www.enterf1.com/where-to-buy-f1-tickets.php) — Ticket buying guide with provider comparisons
- [F1 Competitions](https://www.enterf1.com/f1-competitions.php) — F1-related competitions
- [About](https://www.enterf1.com/about.php) — About the site
- [Contact](https://www.enterf1.com/contact.php) — Contact form

## Race Guides (2026 Season)

Each race page includes circuit details, race date/time, track information, and travel guidance.

- [Australian Grand Prix](https://www.enterf1.com/races/race.php?slug=australian-grand-prix) — Albert Park, Melbourne
- [Chinese Grand Prix](https://www.enterf1.com/races/race.php?slug=chinese-grand-prix) — Shanghai International Circuit
